name: Landing page displays pricing and opens the FAQ

planSteps.description: Navigate to / as a signed-out visitor.
The main heading contains Meet and Krafty Bot, and the View plans link is visible.
Click the hero View plans link to navigate to the Pricing section.
The Pricing heading and free and paid plan options are visible.
Scroll to the FAQ section and expand a closed FAQ question.
The clicked question expands and its answer becomes visible.
